desc.id: Peta tiga jaringan dagang kuno: Jalur Sutra di Asia, jalur laut di Samudra Hindia, dan jalur unta di Gurun Sahara.

spices.note: The lesson says "rempah-rempah"; the short form avoids running over a sea route.

summer wind.note: Font size reduced from 22 to 18 to fit between the coast and "Jalur laut". The lesson only says the monsoon winds change direction twice a year; "musim panas/dingin" follows the English. | Reviewer: Tight fit: in the rendered picture 'angin musim panas' nearly touches the 'Jalur laut' label. Also, Indonesian learners have no summer/winter; the reviewer may prefer a shorter or local wording (e.g. keep as is, or 'angin muson ...') as long as the two winds stay distinct.

winter wind.note: Font size reduced from 22 to 18 to match the summer label and keep clear of Madagascar.

Map of three old trade networks: the Sil.back: A map of three ancient trade networks: the Silk Road in Asia, sea routes in the Indian Ocean, and camel routes in the Sahara Desert.
